title: Vithagan
desc: Rowdhiran, a tough and honest cop, seeks revenge on a criminal gang. However, when Badri, the mob boss, plots his downfall, Rowdhiran decides to go down swinging.

title: Nizhalgal
desc: Three unemployed friends stricken by poverty find it tough to make ends meet. They refuse their parents' advice to take a basic job and instead strive hard to pursue their dreams at any cost.

title: Puthiya Vaarpugal
desc: When Shanmugamani, a teacher of a village school, falls in love with Jothi, a local beauty, an evil village leader tries to break their relationship.

title: Thirumanam Enum Nikkah
desc: Raghav and Priya pretend to be Muslim on a train journey. They fall in love, but their relationship is tested when true identities emerge.
